card.text: Explore Phaethon in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Phaethon is a near-Earth asteroid. Explore its calibrated convex reconstruction from DAMIT, version 2019-12-03. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. This is the 2018 convex reconstruction. Later radar work resolves features this model cannot show.

shape.title: DAMIT model 4394
shape.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
